shared_or_similar_visual_information: A vertical dashed segment inside a mathematical diagram.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The height of the solid, drawn as an interior segment from its apex toward the base. Right image: A guide projecting a selected position on the graph down to its horizontal input coordinate.
Rationales: The guide reaches an input tick on an axis. The segment inside the solid joins its apex to its base level and represents a geometric height.
